notes: The official ISA Sign Expo 2026 exhibitor list is not yet fully published online as of February 2026. The event will take place April 8-10, 2026 at the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, FL. Based on historical data, ISA Sign Expo typically attracts 570-600 exhibitors and 19,500-20,000 attendees. The companies listed represent confirmed 2026 exhibitor (Watchfire Signs), recent exhibitors from 2024-2025 shows who are highly likely to return, and major industry players with consistent ISA participation. All companies identified are relevant to DuPont Tedlar's graphics and signage protective film applications, including manufacturers of printing equipment, vinyl films, overlaminates, sign materials, and distributors serving the sign and graphics industry.
